data.one_liner: Scale the entire UI design proportionally based on device size.
data.what_it_does: Scales every widget, font, button, and image simultaneously across the application. It replaces standard initialization methods to apply a proportional scaling factor to the UI and MediaQuery data.
use_when: you want to scale the entire UI proportionally, not just part of it
avoid_when: you are building a fully responsive fluid layout that adapts per breakpoint
you only want to scale specific components rather than the entire UI
strengths: scales everything simultaneously including text, images, and buttons
simple setup by replacing runApp or WidgetsFlutterBinding
supports enabling and disabling scaling on demand
weaknesses: may not suit designs that require different layouts on different screen aspect ratios
forces a fixed-width design paradigm rather than true responsive design

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides robust adaptive layout, scaling, and breakpoint features for different screen sizes.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows sizing widgets and fonts relative to screen width and height percentages.
